premise: The probe swings past the Moon on its long trip to the far planets; Drone takes its picture, the satellite sends one last message — and the probe sends back a picture of the base.
inspiration: The traveller's farewell of the old ballads, turned: this traveller goes happily, and sends a picture of home back home.
learning: Probes travel for years to reach the far planets, and send their pictures home with a big dish.

en-US.title: The Probe Says Goodbye
en-US.text: {probe:enter} The probe came sailing past the Moon. It had a long way to go: years and years, all the way to the far planets. {astronomer:enter} {astronomer:face happy} Astronomer waved both arms. {astronomer:hop} [excited] Everyone, wave! {drone:float loop 0.3} {drone:enter} Drone zoomed up as high as it could and {drone:live} took the probe's picture. Flash! {probe:live hold} The probe turned its big white dish toward home. For years it would talk to the Earth through that dish, sending back {probe:glow} pictures of places nobody has ever seen. {satellite:enter} The satellite {satellite:live} sent one last message after it: Safe travels! {astronomer:face sad} [softly] Astronomer watched it grow smaller and smaller. Then — {sfx:ping} ping — {astronomer:face surprised} a message came back. A picture. The Moon, and on it a tiny base, and tinier dots, waving. {astronomer:face happy} {all:hearts} [whispers] That's us, she said.

es-ES.title: La sonda se despide
es-ES.text: {probe:enter} La sonda pasó navegando junto a la Luna. Le quedaba muchísimo camino: años y años, hasta los planetas más lejanos. {astronomer:enter} {astronomer:face happy} Astrónoma saludó con los dos brazos. {astronomer:hop} [excited] ¡Todos a saludar! {drone:float loop 0.3} {drone:enter} Dron subió todo lo alto que pudo y {drone:live} le hizo una foto a la sonda. ¡Flash! {probe:live hold} La sonda giró su gran antena blanca hacia casa. Durante años hablaría con la Tierra a través de esa antena, enviando {probe:glow} fotos de lugares que nadie ha visto nunca. {satellite:enter} El satélite {satellite:live} le mandó un último mensaje: ¡Buen viaje! {astronomer:face sad} [softly] Astrónoma la vio hacerse pequeña, cada vez más pequeña. Y entonces — {sfx:ping} pin — {astronomer:face surprised} llegó un mensaje de vuelta. Una foto. La Luna, y en ella una base diminuta, y unos puntitos todavía más diminutos, saludando. {astronomer:face happy} {all:hearts} [whispers] Somos nosotros, dijo.

ping.prompt: a single soft, bright radio ping, like a message arriving, warm and gentle
